builtInBehaviors.description: Composing a trigger with render produces one button element in the DOM and forwards refs from every layer to that button.
The menu popup automatically inherits its trigger's accessible name across text buttons, IconButtons, and triggers named by a label Tooltip, without hidden label elements.
Opening the menu hides its trigger's tooltip (even if the pointer rests on the trigger again), and closing the menu does not flash the tooltip back open when focus returns.
Inactive menu triggers and items with inactiveText stay reachable by keyboard, announce aria-disabled to screen readers, and block activation.
Pressing Escape dismisses one open layer at a time, closing an open submenu, menu, or hovered tooltip without closing an underlying Dialog.
Submenus open on click, ArrowRight, or pointer hover, and close back to their parent item on ArrowLeft or Escape while keeping the parent menu open.

defaultBehaviors.description: Toggling a CheckboxItem keeps the menu open so users can select multiple options in one pass, while RadioItem and Item close the menu immediately.
When a menu item opens a controlled Dialog, closing that Dialog returns keyboard focus to the menu trigger button automatically.

usageGuidelines.description: Attach custom buttons or IconButtons with ActionMenu.Trigger render={<IconButton ... />} (or Tooltip.Trigger render={<ActionMenu.Trigger ... />}) so all behaviors share one button.
Use RadioGroup and RadioItem for single-choice state, and CheckboxItem for multi-select toggles, so screen readers announce selection state.
Use ActionMenu.Button inactive (wrapped in Tooltip only while inactive) or ActionMenu.Item inactiveText when users need to know why an action is unavailable.
Render controlled Dialogs opened from menu items outside ActionMenu.Content so closing the menu does not unmount the open dialog.
Nest a Button or IconButton as children inside ActionMenu.Button; this creates invalid nested buttons.
Pass selected to plain ActionMenu.Item for stateful choices; it draws a visual checkmark without announcing selection to screen readers.
Wrap a native disabled Button in an active Tooltip; disabled buttons are skipped by keyboard Tab, hiding the explanation from keyboard users.
Nest ActionMenu.Content inside ActionMenu.SubmenuTrigger; render SubmenuTrigger and Content as direct siblings inside ActionMenu.Submenu.
Trigger an irreversible danger action (such as deleting data) immediately without a confirmation Dialog or undo path.
